notes: CONFLICT: titles say araM/araP (the evolved lines per the design) while ch:strain gives the ancestors REL606/REL607; design says each file holds the evolved lines and the ancestor, so genotype_class and is_control left out. RNA-seq arm of a ribosome-profiling protocol with 18-50 nt size selection and linker ligation -> assay_class other. Temperature not given.

base_medium.q: Bacteria were grown in the DM25 medium supplemented with 4g/L of glucose.

medium_class.q: Bacteria were grown in the DM25 medium supplemented with 4g/L of glucose.

treatment.q: No treatments were applied to the samples.

inducer_added.q: No treatments were applied to the samples.

transcription_arrested.q: No treatments were applied to the samples.

mixed_organism.q: 2 biological replicates each of RNA-seq and Ribo-seq of 13 E. coli cell lines.

strain_group.q: AraM and AraP refer to the 6 evolved lines of the ancestral REL606 and REL607 strains

assay_class.q: Each sample produced a matched set of RNA-seq and ribo-seq fragments which were size selected to a range of 18-50nt.

rrna_removal.q: rRNA depletion was completed with the Illumina Ribo-Zero rRNA Depletion Kit for bacteria.
